name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is an advanced-stage silver-gold developer advancing its 100%-owned Diablillos project in the Puna region of Salta Province, Argentina. Diablillos hosts one of the largest undeveloped primary silver resources globally, with approximately 248 million ounces of silver and 2.54 million ounces of gold in Measured & Indicated resources. The company received RIGI (Large Investment Incentive Regime) approval from Argentina in 2026 and is advancing a Definitive Feasibility Study toward a production decision.
